mission: Test whether a lineage-local parent/child gate can be recovered without old-token or old-query replay by combining a compact historical query sketch with current conflict queries, before integrating a learned local gate into another continual-language formal experiment.

ownership_semantics.spawned_parent_birth_domain: the phase in which that parent Cell was itself spawned
ownership_semantics.edge_old_domains: all domains from the parent birth domain, inclusive, up to the child birth domain, exclusive
ownership_semantics.conditioning: Samples must reach the edge parent through the frozen root and ancestor lineage decisions before entering the local parent-vs-child diagnostic.
ownership_semantics.example_root_to_B: root4->child8 born in B uses old=A and current=B
ownership_semantics.example_B_child_to_C: child8->child12 born in C uses old=B and current=C

sampling.group_unit: ByteSequenceDataset sequence row; all tokens from one sequence remain in the same train or test split
sampling.old_domain_balancing: equal cap per old domain before concatenation

historical_query_sketch.construction: Fit only on old-domain training groups for the edge, then discard the raw old training queries before gate construction.
historical_query_sketch.expected_float32_storage_per_sketch: count plus approximately d*(rank+2)+rank scalars; for d=384 and rank=16 this is about 27.7 KiB

current_query_statistics.construction: Fit from current conflict-domain training groups; these are current-stream observations and are not replay.

sketch_gate.model: single affine lineage-local gate score(q)=w^T q+b
sketch_gate.estimator: regularized pooled low-rank Gaussian LDA using only historical sketch moments and current-query moments
sketch_gate.covariance_solver: Woodbury inverse over diagonal residual covariance plus concatenated old/current low-rank factors
sketch_gate.operating_threshold: calibrate from the historical sketch Gaussian only to a target 10 percent historical false-positive rate

offline_oracle.purpose: Upper-bound comparator only; never used by the sketch gate.
offline_oracle.train_inputs: raw old/current queries from the training sequence groups
offline_oracle.test_inputs: the same heldout sequence groups used to evaluate the sketch gate

classification_rules.EDGE_LOCAL_QUERY_GEOMETRY_NOT_SEPARABLE: coverage is sufficient but the offline oracle fails its registered median/fraction separability rule under edge-local temporal ownership semantics
classification_rules.QUERY_SKETCH_GATE_FEASIBLE: oracle is separable and the sketch gate satisfies its registered median AUC, edge-floor fraction, normalized oracle recovery, old-FPR and current-TPR thresholds
classification_rules.QUERY_SKETCH_GATE_NOT_FEASIBLE: oracle is separable but the registered compact query-sketch gate fails at least one feasibility threshold

interpretation_boundary: This is a mechanism-selection diagnostic, not a continual-language success/failure claim. A positive result licenses implementation of an online sketch-maintaining learned lineage-local gate in a new untouched formal experiment; a negative result does not alter the completed M3R decision.
